decisions.reason: Changing the fiat on-ramp from Stripe to Coinbase Commerce does not change Brevo as the transactional email provider.
The fiat on-ramp provider change does not alter the $5 automatic referral commission.
Fiat users without wallets still require email-based dashboard access regardless of which fiat on-ramp provider is used.
The provider substitution does not change the requirement that public data APIs remain unauthenticated.
Publishing prize-pool values through public APIs is independent of the selected fiat on-ramp provider.
The fiat on-ramp provider change does not modify SIWE authentication for crypto minting and transfer flows.
Selecting Coinbase Commerce instead of Stripe does not change ticket allocation after a successful mint without a referral code.
The provider substitution does not alter prize-ticket issuance or lifecycle rules for successful referral-code mints.
